h1: Kerrville, TX land clearing for big Hill Country acreage
lede: 9 Arrow Land Service takes on land clearing in Kerrville, TX and across Kerr County. Big ranches, heavy juniper and mesquite call for big machines and a plan for what grows back.

answer.q: Does 9 Arrow do land clearing in Kerrville, TX?
answer.a: Yes, 9 Arrow Land Service does land clearing in Kerrville, TX and across Kerr County. On large ranch tracts, high-horsepower articulated wheel mulchers grind juniper, mesquite and brush in place at production pace. Compact track machines handle the steeper draws and tight spots. Estimates follow a discovery call or site visit.

highlights: Large articulated mulchers for big acreage

sections.h2: Kerr County ranch land on the Edwards Plateau
paras: Kerrville is the Kerr County seat, on the Guadalupe River along I-10 about 65 miles northwest of San Antonio. SH 16 runs north to Fredericksburg, SH 27 runs west to Ingram and east to Comfort, and SH 173 heads south to Bandera.

Kerr County sits on the Edwards Plateau, undulating to hilly ground between about 1,500 and 2,000 feet. Live oak, shinnery oak, juniper and mesquite cover the hills, and cattle, sheep and goats have long led the county's agriculture.

Kerrville is a longer run west from home base, covered under [land clearing in Spring Branch](land-clearing-spring-branch-tx). The route passes Boerne, where we handle [land clearing in Boerne](land-clearing-boerne-tx), then Comfort before reaching Kerr County.

sections.h2: Land clearing in Kerrville at ranch scale
paras: Big Kerr County acreage is where the large articulated wheel machines earn their keep. They bring the horsepower for mass acreage clearing and grind mature hardwoods, heavy juniper and mesquite down to a fine finish.

[Ranch land clearing](ranch-pasture-clearing) with mulchers leaves the soil in place and the root balls in the ground, with no burn piles and nothing to haul. Mass acreage clearing and selective work around oak mottes are both on the table for a Kerrville ranch.

sections.h2: Juniper and mesquite need different plans
paras: Ashe juniper does not resprout from the stump when it is cut below its lowest green branches, so a cedar ground off at the base is gone for good. [Cedar removal](cedar-removal) on Kerr County hills comes down to doing the cut right the first time.

Mesquite behaves differently. Mesquite resprouts from buds at its base after cutting, so a cleared mesquite flat near Kerrville needs follow-up. Our right-of-way maintenance manages aggressive regrowth such as mesquite with tractor and batwing equipment, and mowing with agricultural equipment keeps a reclaimed pasture from closing back in. Mesquite and juniper often share the same Kerr County ranch, so a good plan pairs a one-time juniper clearing with scheduled shredding on the mesquite ground.

sections.h2: Pipeline, power line and fence corridors near Kerrville
paras: [Right of way clearing](right-of-way-clearing) for gas pipelines, power line corridors and waterlines typically runs 30 to 120 feet wide, often 90 feet or more, and routes can stretch for miles across Kerr County ranch land. 9 Arrow is often the first contractor on site, opening the easement ahead of grading crews, dozers and excavators.

Survey data is built into the clearing, so a Kerrville corridor follows the lines your surveyor sets. Fence lines between ranch tracts and pad sites for oilfield and utility projects get the same survey-guided approach. It does not get better.

faqs.q: How many acres a day can you clear near Kerrville?
faqs.a: Acres per day near Kerrville depend on density and terrain. Large high-horsepower machines clear about 1 to 3 acres a day with reasonable tree coverage, and up to 5 acres in lighter conditions. Smaller compact machines run about half an acre to 1 acre per 8-hour day.

faqs.q: Is any tree too big to mulch on a Kerrville ranch?
faqs.a: No tree on a Kerrville ranch is too big for 9 Arrow's equipment, because there is no tree size limit. A tree that takes an hour on a smaller machine can take as little as 15 minutes on a large, high-horsepower machine. That speed difference is why big hardwoods go to the big mulchers.

faqs.q: Do you maintain cleared land near Kerrville after the job?
faqs.a: Yes. 9 Arrow maintains rural, ranch and right-of-way ground from small acreage to more than 1,000 acres, with tractor and batwing equipment on corridors. Ranch properties near Kerrville are scheduled by season and conditions, which keeps mesquite and brush regrowth from taking a cleared pasture back.
